purpose: Define before evaluation what counts as transferable market intelligence so future profitable-mind research cannot cherry-pick attractive post-hoc microstructure findings.

design_audit.change: Added explicit cross-symbol evidence and broader non-teacher confirmation requirements before any teacher result was exposed.

direction_or_magnitude_information.requirement: Must satisfy every frozen V1.1 model stability condition: cross-regime baseline improvement plus cross-symbol baseline improvement and directional consistency on at least three of four representative symbols.
direction_or_magnitude_information.allowed_future_role: candidate contextual information in a separately pre-registered future generation after non-teacher-symbol confirmation

stable_feature_relationship.requirement: Teacher absolute Spearman >= 0.02; same sign in at least three of four evaluation folds; median absolute evaluation Spearman >= 0.02; same sign in at least three of four teacher-panel symbols; median absolute per-symbol teacher Spearman >= 0.02.
stable_feature_relationship.allowed_future_role: candidate compact state variable or feature family after broader confirmation

ofi_incremental_information.requirement: Full model must beat the otherwise identical no-OFI model on both MAE and log loss in at least three of four folds under a fixed model family.
ofi_incremental_information.allowed_future_role: OFI may be retained as distinct causal information rather than redundant imbalance, but must still undergo broader non-teacher-symbol confirmation before integration

trust_or_uncertainty_information.requirement: Teacher-defined bad-state quintile must have at least 1.10x forecast error versus good-state quintile in at least three of four folds.
trust_or_uncertainty_information.allowed_future_role: candidate confidence/risk-context input; cannot become a hard trade gate from this study

rejected_as_nontransferable: relationship seen only in one or two historical regimes
relationship whose sign flips across most regimes
result driven by one or two representative coins
pooled result that fails the frozen cross-symbol criteria
metric improvement requiring post-result threshold or hyperparameter changes
isolated high win rate or return without frozen cross-regime and cross-symbol stability
any conclusion requiring fabricated or interpolated missing order-book history

broader_confirmation_before_future_integ.source: non-teacher symbols from the already verified 24-symbol historical TBT breadth panel
broader_confirmation_before_future_integ.purpose: Confirm transfer beyond the four economical teacher symbols; this remains historical research and is not fresh forward qualification.

future_generation_rule.avoid_hard_gate_by_default: GEN3D/GEN3E experience shows hard filtering can overfit or collapse opportunity coverage; any future gate requires independent preregistration and justification.
